confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge of Moroccan coastal tourist towns, not checked against live menus, booking pages, or current listings. Restaurant and café anchors are moderately confident. Alcohol prices are less certain because Morocco's alcohol pricing and availability vary widely by venue, so beer, cocktail, and wine are lower confidence. Accommodation is least certain, since July is peak season in Essaouira and rates shift with demand. Dorm and private hostel figures are rough, and the 3-star figure is the widest band. Currency conversion from MAD was approximate.
comparable_city_reasoning: Benchmarked against Moroccan coastal tourist towns priced below Marrakech, with budget-to-mid-range food and accommodation and a tourist-facing hostel and guesthouse market. Alcohol anchors were set relative to the local restaurant price level, since direct knowledge of Essaouira bar prices is weak.
